import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem sprint_development_0092 (f : ℕ → ℕ) (n : ℕ) : f^[n] 0 = f^[n] (f 0) := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem sprint_development_0092 (f : ℕ → ℕ) (n : ℕ) : f^[n] 0 = f^[n] (f 0) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [Function.iterate_zero]
  | succ n' => simp [Function.iterate_succ, Function.iterate_succ_apply]
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.sprint_development_0092 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.sprint_development_0092 := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
#print axioms Nl2LeanCandidate.sprint_development_0092

run_cmd do
  let expectedInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanExpected.sprint_development_0092
  let candidateInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanCandidate.sprint_development_0092
  unless expectedInfo.levelParams.length == candidateInfo.levelParams.length do
    throwError "Fixed theorem universe-parameter arity mismatch"
  let candidateType := candidateInfo.type.instantiateLevelParams candidateInfo.levelParams (expectedInfo.levelParams.map Lean.Level.param)
  Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
    unless (← Lean.Meta.isDefEq expectedInfo.type candidateType) do
      throwError "Fixed theorem closed declaration types differ"
